intuition: A booking is valid exactly when it overlaps no already double-booked time.

brute_force.approach: Recompute the overlap count over every event boundary for each tentative booking.

optimal.approach: Store accepted bookings and their pairwise overlap intervals; reject any request intersecting an existing overlap.
optimal.space: O(n^2) overlap intervals in the worst case

edge_cases: Touching half-open intervals do not overlap.
A rejected booking must not modify either stored list.
